problem_statement: The PromQL duration-expression functions currently named `min()` and `max()` conflict in spirit with the existing PromQL aggregate functions of the same name and should be renamed to `least()` and `greatest()` throughout the codebase. Rename both the internal Go identifiers and the user-facing PromQL function names, updating the parser, lexer, printer, and all associated tests and documentation so nothing still refers to the old `min`/`max` duration-expression names.

`ApplyWait` (in server/etcdserver) actually waits for a specific committed index to be applied, but its name doesn't convey that. Rename it (and update its call site(s)) to a name that reflects that it waits for the committed index to be applied.

client/v3's Event-related helper methods currently live outside the generated pb package even though they operate purely on pb types. Move these helper methods into the pb package (api/mvccpb) so they live alongside the types they operate on, and update every call site across the client and any proxy/printer code that used the old location.

The JSON-content-type-related header variables/constants currently declared in the public rest/httpx and rest/httpc packages are implementation details that shouldn't be part of those packages' public surface. Move them into an internal header package (rest/internal/header) and update every place that referenced the old package-level vars, including tests.

problem_statement: Several places in the robustness-testing packages (tests/robustness/model and tests/robustness/validate) reach directly into EtcdState's fields. Extract dedicated accessor methods on EtcdState for this field access and update the model/validate/watch code that currently does it inline to call the new accessors instead.

internal/config and internal/gh each define their own overlapping set of token-type constants. Consolidate these into a single shared set of constants (in whichever package is the more appropriate owner) and update both packages to reference the shared constants instead of duplicating them.

`loopyWriter.processData()` (internal/transport/controlbuf.go) has near-duplicate post-write stream-state handling logic in its empty-DATA-frame and non-empty-DATA-frame code paths. Extract the shared logic into a helper method on loopyWriter and have both paths call it instead of duplicating the logic. While unifying the two paths, also make sure the stream quota check that already runs on the non-empty path also runs on the empty-frame path (safe, since empty DATA frames send 0 bytes and don't change bytesOutStanding).

GetComment (pkg/cmd/discussion/client) takes a full ghrepo.Interface parameter purely to resolve the GraphQL host to query, but it actually resolves the comment by node ID and only ever needs the host string -- mirroring how GetCommentReplies already just takes a host. Change GetComment's signature to take a host string instead of a ghrepo.Interface, and update every caller (including the mock and tests) accordingly.

tsdb/chunkenc's `recode` function returns the generic `Appender` interface, but both of its callers immediately type-assert the result to *HistogramAppender. Tighten recode's signature to return *HistogramAppender directly and remove the now-unnecessary type assertions at both call sites.
